g.text: 03 Set the jumpers and connect the drivers
Use the Fritzing picture for the complete wiring. Match the printed labels on your modules.
Remove ENA / ENB caps on both modules.
Keep each driver’s +5 V output separate from the other driver and the ESP32.
PCA9685 shown before headers are fitted. Use PWM pins 8, 9 and 10; leave CH11 unwired.
